```artifact
// GUI Event Graphs for unit U02_Alarms

// Graph 1: Input Air Line Blocked (Low Pressure) Alarm
AirLineBlocked:
  - Event: "AirLineBlocked"
    - Follow-on: AlarmTriggered("Input Air Line Blocked", SEVERITY_HIGH)

// Graph 2: Input O2 Line Blocked (Low Pressure) Alarm
O2LineBlocked:
  - Event: "O2LineBlocked"
    - Follow-on: AlarmTriggered("Input O2 Line Blocked", SEVERITY_HIGH)

// Graph 3: Inspiratory Pressure Below Threshold Alarm
InspiratoryPressureLow:
  - Event: "InspiratoryPressureBelowThreshold(-4)"
    - Follow-on: AlarmTriggered("Inspiratory Pressure Low", SEVERITY_HIGH)

// Graph 4: Input O2 Line Pressure Too High Alarm
O2LinePressureHigh:
  - Event: "O2LinePressureTooHigh"
    - Follow-on: AlarmTriggered("Input O2 Line Pressure Too High", SEVERITY_HIGH)

// Graph 5: GUI Unresponsive Alarm (1/2 Apnea Time)
GUIUnresponsive:
  - Event: "GUIUnresponsive"
    - Follow-on: AlarmTriggered("GUI Unresponsive", SEVERITY_HIGH)

// Graph 6: Overpressure Alarm (GUI)
OverpressureGUI:
  - Event: "OverpressureDetected"
    - Follow-on: AlarmTriggered("Overpressure", SEVERITY_HIGH)

// Graph 7: Controller Unresponsive Alarm (1/2 Apnea Time)
ControllerUnresponsive:
  - Event: "ControllerUnresponsive"
    - Follow-on: AlarmTriggered("Controller Unresponsive", SEVERITY_HIGH)

// Graph 8: Overpressure Alarm (Controller) above 60 cmH2O
OverpressureController:
  - Event: "OverpressureAbove60cmH2O"
    - Follow-on: AlarmTriggered("Overpressure", SEVERITY_HIGH)

// Helper Node: Alarm Triggered
AlarmTriggered(message, severity):
  - DisplayAlarm(message, severity)
```
